'''"Quick Thumbs"''' was a nickname given to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] operative who specialized in [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] computers and acuiring data. During the [[third Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] arrival platform of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Legacy" />
